LanguageData.LP_NetherilStudyScroll.label: Netherese study scroll
LanguageData.LP_NetherilStudyScroll.description: An introductory lecture left by Netherese arcanists. Requires a psylink and at least Intellectual 6 to read: each hour of reading adds 8 neural heat in exchange for psycaster XP (with VPE) or "Netherese study" (without VPE, the psylink rises one level at 100/200/400/800/1600 study, up to level 6). Each person can gain at most 40 points per day from Netherese scrolls. Can't be worn out by reading.
LanguageData.LP_NetherilArcaneScroll.label: Netherese arcane fragment
LanguageData.LP_NetherilArcaneScroll.description: A fragment recording a spell from some arcane school, with the school written in its name. After 24 hours of reading (faster with quality) you comprehend a psycast of that school no higher than your psylink level, taking no VPE path point and needing no path unlocked first. Each person can comprehend at most 2 per scroll, after which only the study afterglow remains. Each hour of reading adds 4 neural heat.
LanguageData.LP_KarsusScroll.label: Scroll of Karsus
LanguageData.LP_KarsusScroll.description: The scroll written by the Netherese archmage Karsus when he tried to seize the Weave's divinity; there is only one in the world. One full reading takes 40 hours, and each reading leaves a stack of "echo of Karsus". Someone who has read it 7 times with psylink level 6 (VPE psycaster level 20) can start the ascension ritual at the Netherese altar. Can't be traded.
